title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Time Series Foundation Models for Electrical Load Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.28200v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate electrical load forecasting supports power-system operation across countries, regions, cities, and buildings, but repeated development of target-specific models is costly. Time series foundation models (TSFMs) provide reusable pretrained backbones, although multi-domain pretraining may not fully capture load-specific characteristics. This paper compares pretrained inference, full fine-tuning, and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) in terms of forecasting accuracy and adaptation efficiency across four electrical load aggregation levels. MOIRAI 1.0 Large serves as the primary backbone, while Chronos-2 assesses whether the findings transfer across model families. The evaluation covers both in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) settings and examines whether compact adaptation provides consistent gains over strong pretrained checkpoints. Pretrained foundation models outperform the implemented seasonal naive and XGBoost baselin

translated_title: 面向电力负荷预测的时间序列基础模型参数高效适配方法研究
translated_abstract: 精确的电力负荷预测支撑着国家、区域、城市和建筑各层级的电力系统运行，但反复开发针对特定目标的模型成本高昂。时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）提供了可复用的预训练骨干网络，尽管多领域预训练可能无法充分捕捉负荷特有的特征。本文在四个电力负荷聚合层级上，从预测精度和适配效率两方面比较了预训练推理、全量微调和低秩适配（LoRA）方法。研究以MOIRAI 1.0 Large作为主要骨干网络，同时使用Chronos-2来评估研究结论能否跨模型家族迁移。评估涵盖分布内（ID）和分布外（OOD）两种设置，并考察紧凑的适配方法能否在强大的预训练检查点之上带来一致的性能提升。预训练基础模型优于所实现的季节性朴素预测和XGBoost基线方法。
tldr: 本文系统比较了预训练推理、全量微调与LoRA参数高效适配在电力负荷预测中的精度与效率，发现预训练时间序列基础模型已优于传统基线，并评估了紧凑适配方法能否在不同负荷聚合层级、分布内外设置及不同模型家族上带来一致的增益。
